name: @singularity/plugin-packages-string-hash
description: Portable string hashes in plain JS (no node:crypto, no Bun.hash), so every host — the Bun server, central and a browser page — computes the same value: hash53 (cyrb53, a 53-bit number, optionally seeded), hashHex (two seeded cyrb53s, ~106 bits as hex), hash64 (a 64-bit bigint) and sha256Hex (a synchronous SHA-256, identical to node:crypto's hex digest).
